biography: William Manning is currently looking for new opportunities due to the uncertain future of Amzi, where he was working remotely. He previously worked at Stack for two and a half years in Denver. Prior to Stack, William Manning worked at Point Development for about four and a half years, focusing on large-scale shopping centers and a build-to-suit single-tenant retail program. After Stack, he joined National Grid Renewables (formerly Geronimo Power) as the head of their data center development program. William Manning is currently based in Miami, Florida, having moved back to be closer to his family. He originally moved to Denver to get his MBA. He is actively looking for new opportunities and is currently in advanced discussions with BE Infrastructure. He prefers a hybrid work setup (two to three days in the office) and would ideally like to stay in South Florida, but recognizes that remote positions are more prevalent. He is open to other asset classes beyond data centers, such as large warehouses or hospitals, as long as the position offers a similar pay structure and in-person component. William Manning is not interested in working for Hut 8 due to concerns about their partnership with Eric Trump. He has also explored opportunities with Core Scientific and Rowan Digital Infrastructure but found them to have a strong preference for candidates in Denver. Ward mentioned Stream Data Centers as a potential opportunity, as they are a legitimate company with Apollo's backing, operating a fully remote development team, and looking to hire at multiple levels. William Manning will send his resume to Ward, adjusted to include project specifics from his time at Stack.
